title: Sneaker Rotation Log Wear Count Leaderboard
dataSources: StockX market prices (`stockx:price`), GOAT listings (`goat:listing`), Alias sales (`alias:sale`), sneaker rotation logs (`sneaker:rotation`), and deadstock age checks (`deadstock:age`).
app: StockX price alerts, GOAT listing exports, Alias seller settlement logs, sneaker rotation wear trackers, and deadstock age audits ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=sneaker:rotation wear_count=*
| stats sum(wear_count) as total_value, avg(wear_count) as avg_value by silhouette
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks silhouette values by total and average wear count across sneaker rotation log events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `wear_count` values for each sneaker rotation log event and review total and average wear count by silhouette.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total wear count.
grandmaExplanation: It produces which silhouette shows the biggest wear count numbers in your sneaker rotation log data.
